cohort: Deliveries between 2004 and 2014 in the United States, identified using the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project-Nationwide Inpatient Sample (HCUP-NIS) database.
finding: Women with hypothyroidism were more likely to experience a range of pregnancy, delivery, and neonatal complications compared to women without hypothyroidism.
mod_finding: Women with hypothyroidism were more likely to deliver by cesarean section.
